prompt: A town's population of $12{,}500$ grows by $4\%$ in one year. What is the population after that year?

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try a small town: $200$ growing $10\%$ gains $20$, reaching $220$. Compute the increase, then decide whether the question wants the increase or the new total.

learningObjective: Apply a percent increase to a large quantity.

alternativeExplanations.title: Answer the question that was asked
steps: The increase is $500$; the new population is $13{,}000$. Both will appear as choices.
Read whether the question wants "the increase" or "the population after".
This is the single most common way to lose an otherwise trivial percent question.
